visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with blue eyes sits on a light-colored wooden floor in a brightly lit indoor home environment. It looks around with a neutral expression and occasionally sticks its tongue out slightly. Large yellow subtitles appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A grey plush cat head attached to a wooden stick is presented to the white cat. The cat looks at it for a moment, then turns its head away and walks out of the frame. A red 'X' graphic appears over the plush toy. (3) The grey plush cat head is shown in a close-up shot with animated blue teardrop graphics added near its eyes, giving it a crying and rejected appearance. (4) A brown tabby cat emerges from a small arched wooden cat door in a white wall. It walks forward cautiously, focusing its gaze on the plush toy held in front of it. (5) The tabby cat begins to strike the plush head rapidly with its front paws. White speed lines and comic-style impact clouds appear around the toy to emphasize the force and speed of the hits. (6) A close-up of the tabby cat's face reveals animated red flame graphics in its eyes. It continues the rapid-fire punching motion with high intensity and blurred movement. (7) The tabby cat stops its attack and runs away into the distance. The plush head remains still, and a green 'O' circle graphic appears with text indicating 'Emotional Value' has been achieved. (8) The video ends with a white screen showing a cat-head logo wearing a headband and branding text in both Chinese and English.
